items.title: Bitcoin breakout cools as October Fed hike odds hit ~75%
items.excerpt: BTC near $84,490 after Monday’s ~$87,397 high. CME FedWatch: ~75% chance of another hike on Oct 28; ~$271M long liquidations in a $348M wipeout.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $347M, stretching the inflow streak to five days
items.excerpt: Wednesday ~$347M (IBIT ~$166M, FBTC ~$143M). Five-session haul ~$2.65B; no Bitcoin ETF outflow that day. Assets ~$109B.

items.title: Bitcoin miners pivot to AI as hashrate sees deepest drop since 2021
items.excerpt: True hashrate ~18% below the Nov 2025 peak (~1,101 EH/s), now ~934 EH/s. Listed miners reallocate power to AI/HPC; AI-linked miners up ~21% YTD vs pure-plays down ~8%.

items.title: Bitcoin slips below $85,000 as 5% Treasury yield returns
Bitcoin ETF net inflows top $1.7B as assets reach $111B

what_moved: October Fed hike odds near 75% and 10y yields near multi-year highs cool the $87K breakout; spot ETFs still absorb with a 5-day inflow streak (~$2.65B).
